landing.section_features_card_3_text: A tool that fits your style — whether for study, work, or personal journaling. Take notes your way, on the fly, and access them anytime.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.meta: How we collect, use, and protect your data when you build CVs, cover letters, and public profiles.
legal.privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {app} ("we", "us") collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use our website, portal, and mobile apps to create CVs, cover letters, public profiles, run ATS checks, and view analytics.
legal.privacy.s1_body: This policy applies to visitors of our marketing site, registered account holders, and people who interact with a public profile you publish (for example by using a contact form on /u/your-name).
legal.privacy.s2_body: We collect account details (name, email, password or OAuth identity), CV and cover-letter content you enter (work history, education, skills, photos you upload, and similar), public-profile settings and templates, job descriptions you paste into the ATS checker, messages sent through public-profile contact forms, and any support requests you send us.
legal.privacy.s3_body: We collect basic technical and usage data such as IP address, device and browser type, app version, language preference, pages or screens viewed, download-button clicks, and approximate timestamps. Analytics in the product may show you how your public profile or documents are used, based on events we log for that purpose.
legal.privacy.s4_body: We use your information to provide and improve the service: save and sync your CVs and cover letters, render templates and PDFs, host public profiles, run ATS keyword matching against job descriptions you submit, show analytics in your portal, authenticate you, send essential account emails (verification, password reset), and keep the platform secure.
legal.privacy.s5_body: If you enable a public profile, the content you choose to publish is visible to anyone with the link. Messages submitted through a profile contact form are delivered to you and processed so we can operate that feature. You control what you publish and can update or disable the profile from the portal.
legal.privacy.s6_body: When you run an ATS check, we process the job description text you paste together with the CV content you select in order to return a match score, keyword coverage, and suggested fixes. We use this data to perform the check and to improve scoring quality; we do not sell job descriptions or CV content.
legal.privacy.s7_body: We use cookies and similar storage for session authentication, language preference, and essential site function. You can control cookies in your browser; disabling them may prevent sign-in or preference saving.
legal.privacy.s8_body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with infrastructure and service providers that help us host the app, send email, store files, or authenticate via providers you choose (such as Google sign-in), only as needed to operate {app}. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect users and the service.
legal.privacy.s9_body: We keep your account and document data while your account is active. You can edit or delete CVs, cover letters, and profile content in the portal. ats.checks.has_name.label: Name
ats.checks.has_name.tip: Add your first and last name.
ats.checks.has_job_title.label: Job title
ats.checks.has_job_title.tip: Add a clear target job title near the top of your CV.
ats.checks.has_summary.label: Summary
ats.checks.has_summary.fail: Professional summary is missing or too short.
ats.checks.has_summary.tip: Write a summary of at least 50 characters describing your background.
ats.checks.has_experience.label: Work experience
ats.checks.has_experience.tip: Add at least one work experience entry with role and company.
ats.checks.has_education.label: Education
ats.checks.has_education.tip: Add at least one education entry.
ats.checks.has_skills.label: Skills
ats.checks.has_skills.tip: List at least three relevant skills.
ats.checks.has_experience_dates.label: Experience dates
ats.checks.has_experience_dates.fail: Some experience entries are missing dates.
ats.checks.has_experience_dates.tip: Add a start date (YYYY-MM) for each role.
ats.checks.has_email.label: Email
ats.checks.has_email.tip: Add a professional email address ATS systems can parse.
ats.checks.has_phone.label: Phone
ats.checks.has_phone.tip: Add a phone number with country code if possible.
ats.checks.has_address.label: Address
ats.checks.has_address.tip: Add a city or address so recruiters know your location.
ats.checks.experience_detail.label: Experience detail
ats.checks.experience_detail.fail: Experience descriptions are too short or missing.
ats.checks.experience_detail.tip: Describe achievements in each role (at least a few sentences).
ats.checks.action_verbs.label: Action verbs
ats.checks.action_verbs.pass: Experience text uses strong action verbs.
ats.checks.action_verbs.fail: Experience text lacks clear action verbs.
ats.checks.action_verbs.tip: Start bullets with verbs like developed, led, improved, or delivered.
ats.checks.no_first_person.label: No first person
ats.checks.no_first_person.tip: Rewrite in a concise third-person / bullet style without “I” or “my”.
ats.checks.photo_soft_warning.label: Photo
ats.checks.photo_soft_warning.pass: No photo attached (often safer for ATS parsing).
ats.checks.photo_soft_warning.tip: Some ATS parsers struggle with photo-heavy layouts; consider an ATS-classic template without a photo.
ats.checks.pdf_parseable.label: Readable PDF
ats.checks.pdf_parseable.fail: PDF appears unscannable (little or no extractable text).
ats.checks.pdf_parseable.tip: Upload a text-based PDF, not a scanned image. Export from your CV builder or Word as PDF.
ats.checks.pdf_has_email.label: PDF email
ats.checks.pdf_has_email.pass: Email address found in PDF text.
ats.checks.pdf_has_email.fail: No email address found in PDF text.
ats.checks.pdf_has_email.tip: Make sure your email is plain selectable text, not inside an image.
ats.checks.pdf_has_phone.label: PDF phone
ats.checks.pdf_has_phone.pass: Phone number found in PDF text.
ats.checks.pdf_has_phone.fail: No phone number found in PDF text.
ats.checks.pdf_has_phone.tip: Include a phone number as plain text in the header.
ats.checks.pdf_section_headings.label: Section headings
ats.checks.pdf_section_headings.fail: Few or no standard section headings detected.
ats.checks.pdf_section_headings.tip: Use clear headings like Experience, Education, and Skills.
ats.checks.pdf_text_density.label: Text density
ats.checks.pdf_text_density.pass: Text density looks healthy for file size.
ats.checks.pdf_text_density.fail: Low text density — PDF may be image-heavy or scanned.
ats.checks.pdf_text_density.tip: Avoid image-only pages; use real text layers.
ats.checks.pdf_special_chars.label: Special characters
ats.checks.pdf_special_chars.tip: Simplify formatting; avoid decorative symbols and complex tables.
